thread:
Maya: Heads up — took three onboarding calls today (NorthBay, ClearHarbor, Helio). Quick harvest of recurring asks + painpoints. TL;DR: per-route billing confusion, embedding latency on long docs, and lack of admin UI for model pinning. Can we triage priorities for next sprint? @Jon @Aisha @Tom

Tom: :eyes: can you drop the quotes + severity? NorthBay is a renewal watch — they doubled usage then cut prod last week.

Maya: Raw call notes: ```
NorthBay: 'We're getting billed per-route and it's impossible to map to product features, our finance team can't reconcile.' -> Renewal flagged, wants billing toggle or export.
ClearHarbor: 'Search embeddings are slow on our large docs, sometimes times out at ~5k tokens.' -> Impact: search relevance degraded, internal tooling blocked.
Helio: 'No admin UI to pin model versions for different teams; engineers are manually setting env vars.' -> Ask: simple UI + audit log.
```

Jon: Thanks — my quick read: model pinning = highest enterprise impact (reduces ops friction), billing clarity = medium but urgent for renewals, embeddings latency = technical but might be repro-able. Proposed priority: 1) model pinning UI + audit 2) billing docs + export + short-term alias/guide 3) perf investigation (Aisha to repro).

Aisha: Can you share request ids or logs for the latency cases and which model/seq-lengths? I can repro on the dev pool and try kv-cache/quantization angles.

Maya: Yep — ClearHarbor req ids: req_20240315_1123, req_20240315_1145. Model used: redwood-13b-v1, typical seq ~6k tokens, embedding pipeline using batch size 8.

Aisha: Great — I'll try to repro on dedicated dev pool with same batch/seq. If seq length is the cause we might need a prioritized kernel path or batching tweak. Will report back with logs.

Tom: For billing I can scope a small UX help-text + export endpoint. Jon — can product sponsor a quick doc + micro-UX change? That should buy time for a long-term billing view.

Jon: Yep, I'll slot a P1 story for docs + small UX tweak. @Maya can you create a GH/JIRA issue and link customer notes?

Maya: Done — support-bot created ticket CS-5128 and linked to product board: https://redwood.app/board/CS-5128 :white_check_mark:

support-bot: support-bot created jira CS-5128 'Onboarding feedback: billing clarity + model pinning' assigned to @Jon.

Aisha: I'll add repro steps & initial perf numbers to the ticket once I run the tests (ETA tomorrow morning).

Jon: Also note renewal risk: NorthBay wants at least a billing export or toggle before renewal in ~3 weeks. @Tom can you run a quick enablement + temp workaround (doc + alias) while we build the UX?

Tom: On it — I'll schedule a 30m enablement call tomorrow and draft the workaround doc. ETA EOD today for the draft.

Maya: Thanks team. Can we close triage by EOD tomorrow? I'll update CS notes and tag the customers once we have the plan.

Tom: Sounds good.

Jon: Thanks, everyone.
